svg.font-family: Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Four Talbot-family schemes behind a transmission grating
svg.desc: Four schemes behind a transmission grating: a fixed gap inside the Talbot carpet, displacement Talbot with the gap scanned over one Talbot length, achromatic Talbot beyond z_A = 2p²/Δλ with a broadband source, and two gratings whose +m and −m orders cross at ±θ to print fringes of period p/2m.
